svg.title: Covalency — octahedral ligand field splitting
svg.desc: eg at +0.6 Delta-o, t2g at -0.4 Delta-o. Two levels above and three below, at unequal distances that cancel: 2(+0.6) + 3(-0.4) = 0, so the barycentre is conserved and the figure is BALANCED rather than mirrored. Both tiers are centred on the figure's axis, each placed from its own total width — an earlier cut spaced them from the first level's edge, which centred the triple and left the pair 6.5 units to the left, contradicting the one thing the figure is about. GENERATED.
